links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid reading grade level of ChatGPT-4o responses versus recommended 6th-8th grade
links.effect: Average FKGL was 9.5 (10th-grade level), exceeding the recommended sixth to eighth grade patient education standard.
links.quote: Reading level exceeds recommended patient education standards of sixth to eighth grade.

links.outcome: Readability and actionability of AI-generated patient education responses
links.effect: Average FKGL 9.5; PEMAT understandability averaged 62% and actionability 27%.
links.quote: PEMAT scores averaged 62% for understandability and 27% for actionability.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline quality, readability, specificity, and emotional tone of ChatGPT-4o responses to pediatric craniofacial surgery patient vignettes without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
